message.content: {"calls": [{"tool": "chest_xray_classifier", "source_filename": "figures/17158/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To obtain normalized scores for 'Nodule', 'Consolidation', and 'Effusion' to objectively assess the presence of cavitating nodules versus pleural fluid, which is central to distinguishing septic emboli from other options."}, {"tool": "chest_xray_report_generator", "source_filename": "figures/17158/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To generate a detailed morphological description of the opacities indicated by arrows, specifically checking for cavitation, nodule distribution (peripheral vs central), and confirming the extent of pleural effusion to validate the specific features of septic pulmonary emboli described in Option A."}], "reason": "The question requires differentiating septic pulmonary emboli from mimics based on specific radiographic features (cavitating nodules vs. effusion patterns).
